costumes.name: Honeymoon Party
costumes.description:
Isabel costume.
Obtained from an Event Pass.

lines.text: Don't worry, there's nothing to be afraid of. You're safe with me, I promise.
I can't help but wonder what you're doing... and who you're with...
So many sleepless nights... All because I'm thinking of you, darling.

Is that all for our stroll?
Then let's go home. Our home.
You... erm... you give me a reason to keep living.
Now you won't be distracted, not even by those admirers of yours.
Even looking at you makes my heart feel so full. I hope you can understand...
Darling, are you talking to other girls behind my back?
What? That winged statue reminds you of me? Aww, you're making me blush, darling...
There's an awful lot of other Nikkes here... Perhaps I shouldn't have let you come.
I'm here because I missed you.
You're so adorable. I'll get rid of anything standing in your way, anything!
Now I can fly to you faster.
Ah... Is this a form of love?
I'm the only shield you'll need.
Does this mean... You like me too, darling?
With this, it's like you'll always be with me.
A piece of my darling... For me to keep.
From now on, I want to be your one and only.
We love each other, right?
I wish I could sleep by your side every night.
I'll protect you, darling.
Did you call my name...?
I'll go right away.
Bring it on.
Leave everything to me.
I'm the one to keep you safe.
Don't worry. Just get behind me.
No time to waste.
I must keep my darling safe...
Hurry up.
Time to end this.
I'll chase you to the end of the world.
I usually prefer going solo, but there's no other choice.
Die.
Neutralized.
Be gone!
... Ugh.
No.
Ah!
Ugh... No... I can't leave you behind...
I knew you couldn't do it without me... right?

Thank you for inviting me to the party. 
It's an honor to be with you like this.

There are more people here than I expected.
I was hoping this dress would be for your eyes only.

When does this bori—er... splendid party come to a close?
I want to be alone with you.

I was so excited about partying with you all night that I couldn't sleep at all.
Will you put me to bed with a sweet lullaby?

The outfit you're wearing today suits you wonderfully.
What even more splendid things have you prepared for me underneath it?

I was dying to know what your expression would be when you saw me in this outfit.
Seeing it in person is even more enchanting than I imagined.
You can go wherever you like, as long as you're within my sight.
Parties are for socializing, so feel free to talk to the others, Darling... so long as it isn't other women.

Is there somewhere the two of us can enjoy a little party of our own?
There are too many eyes on us here.

Once we're newlyweds, let's build our house around here. 
No need to soundproof it. We can make the walls as thin as possible.
This place is filled with your scent, so it's no wonder I love it.
What do you think of my dress? I've been saving it for you.
Is this more to your liking?
Now you can rely on me more, Darling.
No one but me is allowed to touch you at this party today.
Is this perhaps something to be used for our private party later?
I'll never forget today, ever.
I will treasure it forever, thank you.
I'll be waiting for you tonight.
Is our private party about to begin?
I knew you'd be waiting for me as well.
I guess this is an outdoor party.
Yes, Darling.
Is that our party venue?
There are too many intruders at our private party.
Stay behind me for a moment.
I'll finish this quickly.
I will protect you.
I'm going to be late for the party.
I have someone waiting for me.
I can't disappoint him.
Let's finish this quickly.
Get lost! This is a private party.
There's no time, give it your all.
It's almost done.
It's all taken care of.
... What a hassle.
My dress...!
Ugh...!
Ahh...!
My party with you... ugh... I'm really sorry.

Now that the intruders are all gone,
shall we start our private party?
